text: knowledge-track is enabled at user scope from a directory marketplace pointing at this repo, so every Claude session (any cwd) loads it live from the working tree: kt is plugins/knowledge-track/bin/kt and the SessionStart hook is plugins/knowledge-track/hooks. The ~/.claude/plugins/cache v0.1 copy is unused. Checking out main breaks recording everywhere. When experimenting, point KNOWLEDGE_TRACK_DIR and KT_OBSERVE_DIR at scratch dirs.
